title: [16/11/2024] Percentage of students at an education center
prompt: The charts below show the percentage of students at an adult education centre taking various courses offered in 1985 and this year.
Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The pie charts compare the proportions of students enrolled in different courses at an adult education centre between 1985 and the current year.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, while some courses have maintained their popularity over time, others have been discontinued and replaced with new options. In addition, Modern Languages experienced the most significant decline, while IT emerged as the most popular course in the current year.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at the courses that remained available throughout the period, Modern Languages attracted the highest percentage of students in 1985, at 24%, followed by Fitness and Dance with 22%. Art and Cookery were less popular, accounting for 17% and 14% of total enrollments respectively. By the current year, Modern Languages saw a substantial decrease to 17%, while Fitness and Dance maintained its share at 22%. Meanwhile, although Art's proportion slightly decreased to 15%, Cookery witnessed an increase to 19% of all students.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Regarding other courses, Local History and Music Appreciation, which collectively made up 23% of enrollments in 1985, were no longer offered in the current year. Instead, a new IT course was introduced and quickly became the most popular option, drawing 27% of all students at the centre.
